overview: Patrol Routes is the Seru military corridor through Grimling Forest, used to contain Grimling expansion and monitor Acrylia corruption.
history: Seru expeditionary forces established patrol lines to contain Grimling tribes.
Scout towers were built to monitor forest corruption and Acrylia growth.
Grimling warbands began ambushing patrols along narrow trails.
Acrylia-tainted wildlife started attacking both sides indiscriminately.
Patrol Routes became a permanent contested zone.
hooks: Seru scouts report a massive Grimling ambush forming.
A corrupted beast stalks the patrol lines.
A scout tower collapses due to Acrylia root growth.
Seru forces discover a new Acrylia vein beneath the trail.
